overnightRisk: Next report is ~02:00 COT, and the window spans Friday night into the weekend, when liquidity thins and moves overshoot. Longs are still crowded (1H account ratio 1.47, funding only +0.001%), so a break under 82,307 (4H EMA200) and then 81,612 can cascade toward 80,400; the estimated 25x long-liquidation zone sits near 79.3k. ETF flows are the soft spot (-244M Oct 8, -487M Oct 7; the Oct 9 print is not out yet and spot ETFs do not trade on weekends). Upside is capped by 83.1k-83.5k, where three pushes have already failed. A resting stop near 81,550 is the only protection while nobody is watching.
